name: bunready
positioning: Know what breaks before you move a Node/TS repo to Bun.

blocker.label: blocker
blocker.meaning: Cannot run correctly on Bun until fixed. Fails CI.

risk.label: risk
risk.meaning: Real hazard needing a human judgement call. Does not fail CI.

info.label: info
info.meaning: Context only. Does not fail CI.

terminal.note: Terminal output must stay legible on light and dark themes; never rely on colour alone - every severity also carries a word.

fonts.sans: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
fonts.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

clearSpace.rule: clear space on every side = 0.5 x the mark height
